svg.title: Carnot engines and entropy
svg.desc: (a) A Carnot engine between 600 K and 100 K takes in Q_h = 4000 J and does W = 3333 J of work, giving Q_c = 667 J to the cold reservoir. (b) If the 4000 J first flows irreversibly to a reservoir at 250 K, entropy increases, and a Carnot engine from there to 100 K does only W = 2400 J, giving Q_c = 1600 J to the cold reservoir. Greater entropy overall means less work.
